root.name: ブリストル・マイヤーズ スクイブ

relations.text: 抗凝固薬エリキュイスをファイザーと共同で開発・販売している
relations.text_en: BMS and Pfizer jointly develop and commercialize Eliquis

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Pfizer BMS and Pfizer jointly develop and commercialize Eliquis , an anticoagulant discovered by BMS.

relations.text: オプジーボなどを日本・韓国・台湾で小野薬品と共同開発・販売している
relations.text_en: BMS and Ono jointly develop and commercialize Opdivo and Yervoy in Japan, South Korea and Taiwan

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: BMS and Ono jointly develop and commercialize Opdivo , Yervoy and several BMS investigational compounds in Japan, South Korea and Taiwan.

relations.text: ビオンテックの二重特異性抗体を共同開発・共同販売する提携を結んだ
relations.text_en: BMS entered into a strategic collaboration with BioNTech to co-develop and co-commercialize a bispecific antibody

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: entered into a strategic collaboration with BioNTech to co-develop and co-commercialize BioNTech's investigational bispecific antibody pumitamig (BNT327/BMS986545) across multiple solid tumor types

relations.text: 抗体薬物複合体iza-brenをシストイミューンと共同開発・共同販売する
relations.text_en: BMS and SystImmune co-develop and co-commercialize iza-bren

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: BMS and SystImmune, Inc. ("SystImmune") are parties to a global strategic collaboration for the co-development and co-commercialization of izalontamab brengitecan (iza-bren or BL-B01D1)

companies.name: ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン

relations.text: 血栓症予防薬ミルベキシアンをヤンセンと共同開発している
relations.text_en: BMS and Janssen jointly develop milvexian

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: BMS and Janssen jointly develop milvexian, an investigational oral, highly selective factor XIa inhibitor being studied for the prevention of major thrombotic conditions.

relations.text: Reblozylの権利をメルクからライセンスしている

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: BMS and Merck are parties to a global licensing agreement pursuant to which BMS licenses Reblozyl from Merck.

relations.text: Winrevairの権利をメルクにライセンスし、ロイヤルティを受け取る

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: BMS receives royalties from Merck equal to 22 % of net sales.

relations.text: Tecentriqに関する特許ライセンス契約の相手先である
relations.text_en: Roche is party to a patent license agreement on Tecentriq

source.label: Bristol Myers Squibb 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: BMS and Ono are parties to a global patent license agreement with Roche Group related to Tecentriq *, Roche’s anti-PD-L1 antibody.
